details: The cryptocurrency market saw a substantial downturn, with Bitcoin (BTC) falling below $60,000 for the first time since October 2024. Ethereum (ETH) also experienced a notable decline, dropping by approximately 4%. The broad market sell-off led to nearly $1 billion in liquidations across various crypto positions. This market movement is primarily attributed to higher-than-expected US inflation data, with the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) index rising 4.1% in May, fueling concerns about potential Federal Reserve interest rate hikes. Adding to the bearish sentiment, spot Bitcoin ETFs continued to record significant outflows, including a $239.30 million net outflow from the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF. The Crypto Fear and Greed Index has plummeted into "extreme fear" territory.
title: Global Crypto Market Experiences Significant Sell-Off Amid Inflation Fears

details: While Solana's (SOL) price has fallen by approximately 20% in the last month, reaching multi-year lows, the underlying network activity has shown remarkable growth. In the first quarter of 2026, the Solana network processed a record 25.3 billion transactions, marking its highest quarterly total ever. The stablecoin market capitalization on Solana and monthly active addresses also reached all-time highs. On June 25, 2026, tokenized stock trading volume on Solana hit a record $553 million. Despite this robust on-chain activity, the network's very low average transaction fees (around $0.00) raise questions about how this usage translates into sustainable value for the SOL token.
title: Solana Network Activity Surges Despite SOL Price Decline

details: The Ethereum Option Income Strategy ETF (NYSE: IETH) announced a dividend of $0.0970 per share on June 25, 2026, payable on June 30, 2026. This dividend, however, represents a decrease from the previous payout. Separately, the Ethereum ecosystem is undergoing a governance restructuring, including a 40% budget cut by the Ethereum Foundation. Despite these changes and increased competition, Ethereum continues to be a leader in decentralized finance (DeFi), stablecoins, and real-world asset tokenization, with strong institutional interest. Major financial institutions are increasingly partnering with Ethereum for blockchain adoption, supporting its long-term viability.
title: Ethereum ETF Declares Dividend; Network Fundamentals Remain Strong

details: Pepeto, a new Ethereum-based cryptocurrency, is reportedly days away from a Binance exchange listing after raising $10.3 million in its presale. The project aims to deliver faster transactions and lower fees on the Ethereum network, with its development tools nearing completion and a team led by a former Binance developer. Analysts are suggesting that Pepeto could see significant returns upon its listing on Binance, drawing considerable investor attention.
title: New Ethereum-Based Crypto Pepeto Nears Binance Listing
